messages:
Jori: Quick polish thread 15m please: hero + 3 bullets + bench blurb + CTAs. Need to lock CTAs and demo routing before I schedule publish.
Kay: On hero and short social headline. Will drop two options in the doc in 10.
Felicia: I'll do the benchmark blurb and include test context (hw + avg seq). Plan: median and p95 callouts.
Marc: Webinar ops: can reserve 17:00 PT demo pod for the launch. Suggest we use that for the public demo. Will update Calendly and event copy after CTAs locked.
Jori: Primary CTA = ? (Register demo) Secondary = ? (Request eval?). Thoughts?
Kay: Primary: "Register for launch demo". Secondary: "Request a dedicated eval" (add legal qualifier). Short social: "Ship reliable LLM features 6 lower latency costs."
Felicia: Bench draft: "median latency up to 2.9x faster, p95 up to 1.8x in our internal benchmarks (tests run on A100-equivalent; avg seq ~128)." Keeping "up to" and "internal" per legal guidance.
Alina (Legal): Quick flag: approve wording with "up to" and "internal benchmarks". For "Request a dedicated eval" add "(subject to qualification)". I can sign off by 3:30pm.
Marc: Calendly pinned 17:00 PT demo, event title: "Redwood Beta Launch Demo". I tested registration -> confirmation email looks good.
Jori: HubSpot hidden fields to paste into form:
```
hidden_fields:
  utm_source: newsletter
  utm_campaign: beta_play_through
  demo_slot: 17:00
  lead_route: beta_inbound
```
Marc: Routing rule: utm_campaign=beta_play_through -> assign to "beta-inbound" queue; company_size>200 -> Enterprise SDR. Also set sf_flag=beta_interest on submit.
Kay: Dropped final copy in the doc and social alt. Link: https://docs.google.com/xxx
Alina (Legal): Sign-off added in doc comments. Minor edit: add "internal" next to benchmarks in-line.
Jori: Locking CTAs and bench phrasing. Proposed publish window = tomorrow 11am PT. If no objections by 4pm today Ill schedule publish and queue the tweet thread for +5m. :rocket:
